integrity: All-size proof uses an exhaustive 81-signature theorem supported by standalone category and direct-state checks; finite brute force alone is not used to justify infinity.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to synchronous four-colour threshold-two dynamics on loopless labelled complete graphs with n>=2. Early foundational primary full text was unavailable; historical priority is not guaranteed. Classification has no external independent validation.
title: A singleton-defect clock for four-colour two-contact dynamics on complete graphs
